title: doPlan: A Variable-Horizon Dataset for Multi-Stage Language-Conditioned Planning in Autonomous Driving
title_zh: doPlan：面向自动驾驶中多阶段语言条件规划的可变时域数据集

paragraphs.en: Autonomous vehicles interacting with passengers through natural language must reason beyond immediate commands. Passenger intent may span multiple stages of behavior, depend on future events, refer to surrounding agents or landmarks, and remain relevant as driving conditions evolve. Existing language-enabled driving datasets largely focus on short, localized interactions, leaving these longer-horizon forms of passenger intent comparatively underexplored. We introduce doPlan , to our knowledge the first publicly available, human-annotated real-world dataset designed to study passenger language as persistent task context. Built on nuPlan, doPlan contains 5,154 human-written passenger instructions spanning 169.1 hours of cumulative instruction-aligned context over 50.9 hours of unique driving, with annotation windows ranging from 30.0 to 508.8 s. The annotations capture immediate, deferred, event-conditioned, persistent, and multi-stage passenger intent. The dataset, annotation interface, and supporting resources are publicly available at https://github.com/Mi3-Lab/doPlan . We evaluate four language-conditioned driving models and find that sensitivity to passenger language does not reliably translate into behavior consistent with the requested direction. More broadly, among 2,161 examples with a matched future maneuver, the first associated maneuver occurs a median of 24.6 s after the evaluation point, and only 9.8% occur within the models’ common 5 s prediction horizon. These findings highlight the need to connect persistent passenger intent with successive planning decisions. doPlan provides a setting for studying how unresolved goals can be retained, grounded in evolving scenes, and tracked across multiple stages, including how a planner determines when a future goal becomes relevant to the current plan.
paragraphs.zh: 通过自然语言与乘客互动的自动驾驶车辆必须能够超越即时指令进行推理。 乘客的意图可能跨越多个行为阶段，依赖未来事件，涉及周围的其他智能体或地标，并随着驾驶条件的变化而保持相关性。 现有的支持语言交互的驾驶数据集主要关注短期、局部化的互动，因此这类具有更长时间跨度的乘客意图形式尚未得到充分研究。 我们提出了 doPlan——据我们所知，这是首个公开可用、由人类标注的真实世界数据集，旨在将乘客的语言作为持续的任务上下文进行研究。 doPlan 基于 nuPlan 构建，包含 5,154 条由人类撰写的乘客指令，这些指令对应的累计上下文时长为 169.1 小时，覆盖 50.9 小时的独特驾驶过程，标注时间窗口范围从 30.0 秒到 508.8 秒不等。 这些标注涵盖了即时、延迟、事件触发、持续以及多阶段的乘客意图。 该数据集、标注界面及相关资源可在 https://github.com/Mi3-Lab/doPlan 公开获取。 我们评估了四种基于语言条件的驾驶模型，发现模型对乘客语言的敏感程度并不总能转化为与所请求方向一致的行为。 更广泛地看，在 2,161 个具有匹配未来操作的示例中，首个相关操作在评估点之后平均延迟 24.6 秒才发生，且仅有 9.8% 的操作发生在模型通常的 5 秒预测时间范围内。 这些发现凸显了将持续性的乘客意图与连续规划决策相连接的必要性。doPlan 提供了一个研究场景：未解决的目标如何被保留、如何在不断变化的环境中保持依据，并如何在多个阶段中被追踪，包括规划器如何判断未来目标何时对当前计划具有相关性。

paragraphs.en: As robots expand from performing structured tasks, such as package sorting and repetitive component assembly, to operating in everyday human environments (e.g., assisting with household chores and navigating public roads), they will increasingly need to understand not only what a person wants them to do now, but what that person is trying to accomplish beyond the next action. Human instructions often communicate such broader intent through contextual or temporally extended language, in which some parts may be immediately actionable while others depend on how the surrounding situation unfolds. For example, a person might ask a household robot to “bring me the mug after the kettle boils.” Following even this simple request requires the robot to ground the referenced objects, retain a pending goal, recognize when the relevant condition has been satisfied, and act at the appropriate time. Natural language provides a flexible way to communicate such intent because it can express goals, constraints, references, preferences, and sequences of behavior without relying on a predefined command vocabulary. In prior work, language has been used to specify high-level robotic goals that unfold over multiple actions and to connect perception, reasoning, and physical action [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 ] . However, as instructions persist while the environment changes, the challenge extends beyond interpreting what was said: a system must preserve unresolved intent, ground that intent in new observations, and determine when each part of the instruction should influence the current action.
paragraphs.zh: 随着机器人从执行结构化任务（例如包裹分拣和重复性组件组装）扩展到在人类日常环境中运作（例如协助处理家务和在公共道路上导航），它们将越来越需要不仅理解一个人当下希望它们做什么，还要理解这个人试图在完成下一步行动之外实现什么目标。 人类的指令通常通过上下文相关或时间上延续的语言来表达这种更广泛的目标，其中某些部分可能可以立即执行，而另一些部分则取决于周围情况如何发展。 例如，一个人可能会要求家庭机器人“水壶烧开后把杯子拿给我”。即使是遵循这样一个简单的请求，也需要机器人将所提及的对象与具体情境对应起来、保留待完成的目标、识别相关条件何时满足，并在适当的时候采取行动。 自然语言为传达此类目标提供了一种灵活的方式，因为它可以在不依赖预定义命令词汇表的情况下表达目标、约束、指代、偏好和行为序列。 在以往的研究中，语言已被用于指定需要多个行动步骤才能实现的机器人高层目标，并连接感知、推理和物理行动 [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 ] 。 然而，由于指令在环境变化时仍然存在，这一挑战不仅涉及对已说内容的理解：系统还必须保留尚未解决的目标，根据新的观察信息重新确认该目标，并确定指令的每个部分应在何时影响当前行动。

paragraphs.en: In autonomous driving, this problem becomes especially tangible because passenger instructions can span different temporal horizons. Some requests describe a near-term maneuver, such as “turn left at this intersection,” while others span multiple stages of the drive. Consider a passenger who says, “stay in this lane until we pass the construction, then get over for the next exit.” The vehicle must maintain the current lane, recognize when the construction has been passed, retain the later lane-change goal, account for surrounding traffic, and transition when appropriate. As autonomous vehicles take on more low-level driving decisions, passenger requests may increasingly operate at a higher level, expressing goals, preferences, and contingencies rather than individual maneuvers. In this setting, passenger language becomes persistent task context whose relevance to immediate motion changes as the scene evolves.
paragraphs.zh: 在自动驾驶中，这个问题变得尤为具体，因为乘客的指令可能跨越不同的时间范围。 有些请求描述的是短期内的操作，例如“在这个路口左转”，而另一些则涉及驾驶过程中的多个阶段。 假设一位乘客说：“保持当前车道直到我们经过施工路段，然后在下一个出口变道。”车辆必须维持当前车道，识别何时已通过施工路段，保留后续的变道目标，考虑周围交通状况，并在适当的时候完成变道。 随着自动驾驶车辆承担更多低层级的驾驶决策，乘客的请求可能会越来越多地运行在更高层级上，表达目标、偏好和应急方案，而非单个操作。 在这种情境下，乘客的语言成为一种持续的任务上下文，其与实际动作的相关性会随着场景变化而改变。

paragraphs.en: These requirements arise within a broader literature on language-enabled autonomous driving. Prior work has used language to explain model behavior [ 5 ] , ground human advice and passenger commands [ 6 , 7 ] , answer questions about driving scenes [ 8 , 9 , 10 , 11 ] , and condition predicted trajectories or driving actions [ 12 , 13 ] . Collectively, these efforts establish language as a useful means of understanding driving scenes and specifying or influencing vehicle behavior. However, they largely study localized scenes or short-horizon interactions. The temporal setting considered here is different: passenger intent may remain relevant while the corresponding behavior is not yet actionable, leaving instructions that persist across multiple stages of an evolving drive comparatively underexplored.
paragraphs.zh: 这些需求源于关于语言赋能自动驾驶的更广泛文献。 先前的研究已利用语言来解释模型行为 [5]、依据人类建议和乘客指令进行定位 [6, 7]、回答有关驾驶场景的问题 [8, 9, 10, 11]，以及为预测的轨迹或驾驶动作设定条件 [12, 13]。 总体而言，这些努力确立了语言作为理解驾驶场景以及指定或影响车辆行为的有效手段。 然而，这些研究大多局限于局部场景或短期互动。 本文考虑的时间设定有所不同：乘客的意图可能仍然有效，但相应的行为尚未具备可操作性，这使得贯穿动态驾驶过程多个阶段的指令尚未得到充分探索。

paragraphs.en: Closest to this setting, doScenes introduced free-form human passenger instructions for 1,000 real-world nuScenes clips [ 14 ] . Using the “taxi test,” annotators describe what they would have told a driver to produce the observed behavior, grounding language in intended vehicle behavior rather than only in scene description. However, doScenes associates each instruction with a fixed 12 s driving clip, leaving passenger intent that unfolds across longer and multi-stage driving contexts largely outside its scope. Subsequent work showed that these instructions can influence VLA trajectory predictions when used as conditioning input [ 15 ] . This leaves a natural temporal question: what changes when passenger intent persists beyond a single short driving scene?
paragraphs.zh: 与此设定最接近的是 doScenes，它为 1,000 个真实世界的 nuScenes 片段引入了自由形式的乘客指令 [ 14 ] 。 在“出租车测试”中，标注人员会描述他们会对驾驶员下达怎样的指令以产生所观察到的行为，从而将语言与预期的车辆行为联系起来，而不仅仅是场景描述。 然而，doScenes 将每条指令与一个固定的 12 秒驾驶片段相关联，这使得在更长时间和多阶段驾驶情境中逐渐展开的乘客意图基本超出了其研究范围。 后续研究表明，当这些指令被用作条件输入时，会影响 VLA 的轨迹预测 [ 15 ] 。 这引出了一个自然的时序问题：当乘客意图持续超过单个简短驾驶场景时，会发生什么变化？

paragraphs.en: We introduce doPlan , a human-annotated dataset built on the nuPlan driving dataset [ 16 ] for studying free-form passenger instructions over extended and evolving driving contexts. doPlan contains 5,154 human-written passenger instructions spanning 169.1 hours of cumulative instruction-aligned context across 50.9 hours of unique annotated driving, anchored to variable-duration windows ranging from 30.0 to 508.8 s. Following the taxi-test principle, annotators write what they would have told a driver to produce the behavior observed within each sampled segment. Because these windows are long enough for behavior to unfold in stages, the resulting instructions include ordered maneuvers, deferred actions, and behaviors that persist until a condition is satisfied.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate OpenEMMA [ 17 ] , AutoVLA [ 18 ] , Alpamayo 1.5 [ 19 ] , and Alpamayo 2.0 [ 20 ] under matched language conditions to characterize how current language-conditioned driving models use passenger instructions. Two gaps emerge. First, language sensitivity does not reliably translate into instruction following: stronger conditioning can alter predicted trajectories without improving directional compliance. Second, the behaviors associated with passenger instructions often lie well beyond current short-horizon prediction windows. Together, these results motivate treating passenger language as persistent task context rather than as a one-shot perturbation to the next trajectory.

paragraphs.en: Large-scale autonomous-driving datasets such as KITTI [ 21 ] , the Waymo Open Dataset [ 22 ] , and nuScenes [ 23 ] have established benchmarks for perception, forecasting, and multimodal scene understanding, while nuPlan extends this setting toward motion planning over continuous real-world driving sequences [ 16 ] . doPlan builds on nuPlan by adding free-form passenger instructions aligned with variable-duration driving contexts.
paragraphs.zh: KITTI [21]、Waymo Open Dataset [22] 和 nuScenes [23] 等大型自动驾驶数据集已为感知、预测和多模态场景理解建立了基准，而 nuPlan 则将这一框架扩展到了连续的真实世界驾驶序列中的运动规划领域 [16]。doPlan 在 nuPlan 的基础上进一步引入了与可变时长驾驶情境相契合的自由形式乘客指令。

paragraphs.en: Natural language has increasingly moved from describing and reasoning about driving scenes toward directly influencing vehicle behavior. Earlier work studied explanations, human advice, scene understanding, and grounded passenger commands [ 5 , 6 , 7 , 9 , 10 ] , while more recent approaches use language for instruction-conditioned planning, closed-loop driving, language–action alignment, and vision–language–action modeling [ 24 , 25 , 26 , 13 , 27 ] . For example, the Honda Research Institute Advice Dataset (HAD) [ 6 ] contains 30 hours of driving video data with associated natural language advices which give a goal for or otherwise inform the driving behavior. These works establish the importance of language-conditioned driving, but generally study instructions within relatively bounded scenes or planning episodes.
paragraphs.zh: 自然语言正越来越多地从描述和推理驾驶场景，转向直接影响车辆行为。 早期的研究关注解释、人类建议、场景理解以及基于实际场景的乘客指令 [ 5 , 6 , 7 , 9 , 10 ]，而近期的方法则利用语言进行指令条件规划、闭环驾驶、语言–动作对齐以及视觉–语言–动作建模 [ 24 , 25 , 26 , 13 , 27 ]。 例如，本田研究所建议数据集（HAD）[ 6 ]包含30小时的驾驶视频数据，并附有相关的自然语言建议，这些建议为驾驶行为提供目标或提供其他指导。 这些研究确立了语言条件驱动的重要性，但通常是在相对受限的场景或规划阶段内研究指令。

paragraphs.en: Longer-term temporal structure has been explored more directly in navigation and robotics. Talk2Nav studies long-range route instructions whose components become relevant as navigation progresses [ 28 ] , while Lang2LTL grounds ordered and temporally constrained natural-language tasks into formal specifications [ 29 ] . Within autonomous driving, doScenes is closest to our passenger-oriented setting, collecting free-form human instructions for fixed 12-second nuScenes clips using the taxi-test protocol [ 14 ] . doPlan follows the same annotation principle but extends it to continuous nuPlan contexts spanning 30.0–508.8 s, enabling the study of passenger intent that may span multiple stages, remain pending until future events occur, or persist as driving conditions evolve.
paragraphs.zh: 在导航和机器人领域，长期时间结构已被更直接地探索。 Talk2Nav 研究了长距离路线指令，其各个组成部分会随着导航进程而变得相关 [ 28 ]，而 Lang2LTL 则将有序且具有时间约束的自然语言任务转化为形式化规范 [ 29 ]。 在自动驾驶领域，doScenes 最接近我们面向乘客的设定，它通过出租车测试协议为固定的 12 秒 nuScenes 片段收集自由形式的指令 [ 14 ]。doPlan 遵循相同的标注原则，但将其扩展至持续时间为 30.0–508.8 秒的连续 nuPlan 上下文，从而能够研究可能跨越多个阶段、在将来事件发生前仍处于待处理状态，或随驾驶条件变化而持续存在的乘客意图。

paragraphs.zh: doPlan 完全由官方的 nuPlan 训练数据分集构建而成，该分集提供了连续的真实世界驾驶日志，并同步记录了摄像头和车辆轨迹数据。 摄像头流经过预处理，被转换为同步的视频片段，同时保留了 nuPlan 原有的时间索引，从而确保每个标注与所记录驾驶过程的相应部分保持对齐。

paragraphs.en: Annotations are collected through a custom interface that presents eight synchronized camera views and a heading-aligned map of the surrounding road network. The camera views provide front, side, and rear context, while the map and compass provide additional information about road geometry, upcoming turns, cardinal direction, and nearby landmarks. This context helps annotators formulate passenger instructions that reflect the broader spatial and driving situation shown in the segment.
paragraphs.zh: 标注工作通过一个自定义界面进行收集，该界面展示了八个同步的摄像头视图以及一个与行驶方向对齐的周边道路网络地图。 摄像头视图提供了前方、侧面和后方的环境信息，而地图和指南针则提供了有关道路几何形状、即将出现的转弯、基本方向以及附近地标等额外信息。 这些背景信息有助于标注人员制定乘客指令，以反映该片段中展示的整体空间环境和驾驶状况。

paragraphs.en: To generate annotation candidates, doPlan samples variable-length intervals from continuous nuPlan driving sequences. For a sequence of duration T T , we first sample a segment duration L ∼ Uniform ⁡ ( 30 , T ) L\sim\mathrm{Uniform}(30,T) and then sample its start time S ∼ Uniform ⁡ ( 0 , T − L ) S\sim\mathrm{Uniform}(0,T-L) . This produces contexts ranging from relatively short maneuvers to substantially longer driving episodes. We sample directly from continuous trajectories without preselecting maneuver or scenario categories, and sampled intervals may overlap by design, allowing partially shared driving contexts to receive independent passenger instructions. The 30 s minimum provides sufficient temporal context for extended instruction generation while preserving broad scenario coverage.
paragraphs.zh: 为了生成标注候选项，doPlan 会从连续的 nuPlan 驾驶序列中采样可变长度的区间。 对于一个持续时间为 T 的序列，我们首先采样一个持续时长为 L 的片段，其中 L ∼ Uniform(30, T)，然后采样其开始时间 S，满足 S ∼ Uniform(0, T-L)。 这样生成的上下文既包括相对较短的操作过程，也包括明显更长的驾驶片段。 我们直接从连续轨迹中采样，而不会预先选择操作或场景类别；根据设计，所采样的区间可以重叠，从而允许部分共享的驾驶上下文接收独立的乘客指令。 30 秒的最短时长为生成较长的指令提供了足够的上下文时间，同时仍能保持对多种场景的广泛覆盖。

paragraphs.en: doPlan uses a passenger-oriented annotation protocol based on the “taxi test.” As annotators review each driving segment, they formulate an instruction they could plausibly have given to a driver to produce the observed driving behavior. They are asked:
paragraphs.zh: doPlan 采用一种以乘客为导向的标注协议，该协议基于“出租车测试”。在标注员审阅每个驾驶片段时，他们需要构想出一条自己可能向司机下达的指令，从而产生所观察到的驾驶行为。他们被要求：

paragraphs.en: “Imagine you are a passenger in this taxi. What instruction would you give the driver to produce the behavior you see in the video?”
paragraphs.zh: “想象一下，你是这辆出租车里的一名乘客。 你会给司机下达什么指令，才能让他表现出视频中那样的行为？”

sents.en: “Imagine you are a passenger in this taxi.
sents.zh: “想象一下，你是这辆出租车里的一名乘客。

sents.en: What instruction would you give the driver to produce the behavior you see in the video?”
sents.zh: 你会给司机下达什么指令，才能让他表现出视频中那样的行为？”

paragraphs.en: This framing is intended to elicit instructions that a passenger could reasonably give to a driver, rather than descriptions of the scene or direct summaries of the recorded trajectory. Annotations are collected without a predefined template or command vocabulary and may take several forms: (i) a single-clause instruction (e.g., “turn left at the next intersection”), (ii) a multi-clause or multi-sentence instruction when the observed behavior spans multiple stages (e.g., “stay in this lane until we pass the construction, then move left for the next exit”), or (iii) a no-instruction submission when the annotator does not identify a plausible passenger directive for the observed behavior nor a need to provide instruction based on the scene simplicity. No-instruction submissions are retained as valid annotation outcomes for accounting purposes but are excluded from the passenger-instruction set.
paragraphs.zh: 这种设定旨在引导智能体生成乘客可能合理给予司机的指令，而非对场景的描述或对记录轨迹的直接总结。 标注过程不使用预定义的模板或命令词汇库，标注结果可能呈现多种形式：(i) 单从句指令（例如，“在下一个路口左转”），(ii) 当观察到的行为涉及多个阶段时，使用多从句或多句指令（例如，“保持当前车道直到我们经过施工路段，然后在下一个出口处向左变道”），或 (iii) 无指令提交，即标注者既未识别出与观察行为相关的合理乘客指令，也未认为基于场景的简单性有必要提供指令。 出于统计目的，无指令提交仍被视为有效的标注结果，但会被排除在乘客指令集合之外。

paragraphs.en: The sampled temporal window defines the driving context shown to the annotator; it does not specify when a passenger would have given the instruction during the drive. In particular, the first frame of the window should not be interpreted as the moment the instruction was spoken. The annotation protocol allows instructions to refer to information that a passenger could reasonably know from the route or surrounding environment, including landmarks, upcoming turns, and other contextual information beyond what is visible in a single frame.

paragraphs.en: A central design choice in doPlan is the use of substantially longer driving contexts than those provided by prior instruction-conditioned driving datasets. An important question is whether these extended windows contain additional information related to the passenger instruction, rather than simply adding more video around the same short-term behavior. We therefore use a learned video–instruction matcher built on CLIP to test whether additional temporal context contains instruction-relevant information. The matcher extracts visual features from front-camera frames and text features from each candidate instruction, then learns to assign higher similarity to matching video–instruction pairs than to mismatched pairs.
paragraphs.zh: doPlan 的一个核心设计选择是，使用比先前基于指令的驾驶数据集所提供的驾驶上下文要长得多的上下文。 一个重要的问题是：这些扩展的时间窗口是否包含与乘客指令相关的额外信息，而不仅仅是围绕相同的短期行为添加更多视频内容。 因此，我们使用基于 CLIP 构建的视频–指令匹配器，来检验额外的时间上下文是否包含与指令相关的信息。 该匹配器从前置摄像头帧中提取视觉特征，并从每个候选指令中提取文本特征，然后学习为匹配的视频–指令对分配比不匹配的对更高的相似度。

paragraphs.en: As a natural starting point, we examine whether contemporary language-conditioned driving models meaningfully use the passenger instructions in doPlan when predicting vehicle trajectories. OpenEMMA, AutoVLA, Alpamayo 1.5, and Alpamayo 2.0 were evaluated zero-shot using their native sensor configurations. For each evaluated instruction, we evaluate the models at the earliest time point within the annotated driving segment for which the required sensor history and future trajectory are available. This evaluation time point coincides with the start of the annotation window in 85.0% of cases; otherwise, it occurs 0.2–4.6 s later, with a median offset of 2.8 s. For a given model and example, the same sensor observations at this time point are used across all language conditions, such that only the language input changes. This controlled setup allows us to ask whether changes in predicted behavior can be attributed to the passenger language itself. This evaluation time point serves as the common reference for trajectory prediction and subsequent temporal analyses and should not be interpreted as the time at which a passenger would have spoken the instruction.
paragraphs.zh: 作为一个自然的起点，我们考察当代语言条件驱动的模型在预测车辆轨迹时，是否真正利用了 doPlan 中的乘客指令。 使用其原生传感器配置，通过零样本方式对 OpenEMMA、AutoVLA、Alpamayo 1.5 和 Alpamayo 2.0 进行了评估。 对于每个被评估的指令，我们在标注驾驶片段中最早的时间点评估这些模型，此时所需的传感器历史数据和未来轨迹均已可用。 在 85.0% 的情况下，该评估时间点与标注窗口的起始时间一致；否则，它会在 0.2–4.6 秒之后出现，中位偏移量为 2.8 秒。 对于给定的模型和示例，在此时间点使用的传感器观测数据在所有语言条件下均相同，因此只有语言输入发生变化。 这种受控的设置使我们能够探究预测行为的变化是否可以归因于乘客的语言本身。 该评估时间点是轨迹预测及后续时间分析的共同参考点，不应被解释为乘客发出指令的时间。

sents.en: As a natural starting point, we examine whether contemporary language-conditioned driving models meaningfully use the passenger instructions in doPlan when predicting vehicle trajectories.
sents.zh: 作为一个自然的起点，我们考察当代语言条件驱动的模型在预测车辆轨迹时，是否真正利用了 doPlan 中的乘客指令。

sents.en: OpenEMMA, AutoVLA, Alpamayo 1.5, and Alpamayo 2.0 were evaluated zero-shot using their native sensor configurations.
sents.zh: 使用其原生传感器配置，通过零样本方式对 OpenEMMA、AutoVLA、Alpamayo 1.5 和 Alpamayo 2.0 进行了评估。

sents.en: For each evaluated instruction, we evaluate the models at the earliest time point within the annotated driving segment for which the required sensor history and future trajectory are available.
sents.zh: 对于每个被评估的指令，我们在标注驾驶片段中最早的时间点评估这些模型，此时所需的传感器历史数据和未来轨迹均已可用。

sents.en: This evaluation time point coincides with the start of the annotation window in 85.0% of cases; otherwise, it occurs 0.2–4.6 s later, with a median offset of 2.8 s.
sents.zh: 在 85.0% 的情况下，该评估时间点与标注窗口的起始时间一致；否则，它会在 0.2–4.6 秒之后出现，中位偏移量为 2.8 秒。

sents.en: For a given model and example, the same sensor observations at this time point are used across all language conditions, such that only the language input changes.
sents.zh: 对于给定的模型和示例，在此时间点使用的传感器观测数据在所有语言条件下均相同，因此只有语言输入发生变化。

sents.en: This controlled setup allows us to ask whether changes in predicted behavior can be attributed to the passenger language itself.
sents.zh: 这种受控的设置使我们能够探究预测行为的变化是否可以归因于乘客的语言本身。

sents.en: This evaluation time point serves as the common reference for trajectory prediction and subsequent temporal analyses and should not be interpreted as the time at which a passenger would have spoken the instruction.
sents.zh: 该评估时间点是轨迹预测及后续时间分析的共同参考点，不应被解释为乘客发出指令的时间。

paragraphs.en: For each model, we evaluate four conditions designed to distinguish instruction-specific behavior from generic sensitivity to language: no instruction; the corresponding human-written passenger instruction; an unrelated human-written instruction drawn from a different clip (e.g., a passenger instruction associated with another driving scene); and a rule-based counterfactual intended to request different behavior in the same scene (e.g., “change to the right lane” becomes “change to the left lane”). All predicted trajectories are standardized to a common egocentric representation at ten 0.5 s intervals over a 5 s horizon, the longest horizon shared by all four models.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个模型，我们评估了四种旨在区分特定指令行为与对语言的一般性敏感性的条件：无指令；对应的人类编写的乘客指令；从不同片段中选取的无关人类编写指令（例如，与另一个驾驶场景相关的乘客指令）；以及一种规则化的反事实指令，旨在要求在同一场景中产生不同的行为（例如，“变更到右侧车道”变为“变更到左侧车道”）。 所有预测轨迹都被标准化为一种共同的以自我为中心的表示形式，在 5 秒的时间范围内每隔 0.5 秒记录一次，这是四个模型共有的最长时间范围。

paragraphs.en: Table V shows that providing the corresponding passenger instruction does not consistently improve trajectory alignment over the no-instruction baseline. paragraphs.en: More importantly, the correct passenger instruction produces ADE values similar to those obtained with unrelated and counterfactual instructions across all four models, suggesting that the models do not reliably distinguish the intended instruction from semantically mismatched language. paragraphs.en: We find that increasing navigation guidance produces larger changes in the predicted trajectory, but this does not establish that those changes agree with the passenger’s requested direction. We examine this using a subset of 851 instructions containing a single left- or right-turn request and no additional detected actions (475 left, 376 right). For 612 of these instructions, we identify a corresponding turn in the requested direction from the recorded nuPlan ego trajectory.
paragraphs.zh: 我们发现，增加导航引导会使预测轨迹产生更大的变化，但这并不能证明这些变化与乘客所请求的方向一致。 我们使用一个包含 851 条指令的子集来检验这一点，这些指令仅包含一次左转或右转请求，且没有其他检测到的动作（其中 475 条为左转，376 条为右转）。 在这些指令中，有 612 条的对应转向可以从记录好的 nuPlan 自我轨迹中识别出来，且转向方向与请求一致。

paragraphs.en: We then consider when these matched turns occur relative to the models’ predictions and find that only 4.4% begin within the common 5 s prediction horizon, revealing a substantial temporal mismatch between the requested maneuver and the trajectory available for evaluation. For most directional instructions, the corresponding turn begins after the predicted trajectory ends. An immediate lateral response is therefore not expected in many cases, and its absence cannot by itself be interpreted as failure to follow the passenger instruction.
paragraphs.zh: 接着，我们考察这些匹配转弯相对于模型预测的发生时间，发现仅有 4.4% 的转弯发生在共同的 5 秒预测时域内，这表明所请求的操作与可供评估的轨迹之间存在显著的时间错配。 对于大多数方向指令，相应的转弯都在预测轨迹结束后才开始。 因此，在许多情况下，并不会立即出现横向响应，而响应的缺失本身并不能被解释为未能遵循乘客的指令。

paragraphs.en: We therefore evaluate directional compliance only for the matched turns that begin within the 5 s horizon. We measure whether the predicted 5 s endpoint lies at least 1 m toward the requested side, and additionally test a left–right counterfactual in which the requested direction is reversed while holding the observation and sampling seed fixed. We measure counterfactual directional consistency by requiring both the original and reversed instructions to produce motion toward their respective requested sides.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，我们仅对在 5 秒时间范围内开始的匹配转弯进行方向性合规性评估。 我们测量预测的 5 秒终点是否至少向请求侧偏移了 1 米，并进一步测试一个左右反事实场景：在保持观察数据和采样种子不变的情况下，将请求的方向反转。 我们通过要求原始指令和反转指令都产生朝向各自请求侧的运动，来衡量反事实方向一致性。

paragraphs.en: These results separate two requirements of instruction following: understanding what the passenger wants and understanding when that request should influence the active motion plan. An early directional response is not necessarily incorrect, since road curvature, lane positioning, and preparation for an upcoming maneuver may legitimately influence the trajectory before the turn begins. We therefore treat this experiment as a diagnostic of temporal grounding rather than proof of premature execution: a planner may encode the correct future intent without sharply separating that intent from the behavior that is appropriate now.
paragraphs.zh: 这些结果将指令遵循的两个要求区分开来：理解乘客想要什么，以及理解该请求何时应影响当前的运动计划。 早期的方向性响应并不一定错误，因为道路曲率、车道定位以及对即将进行的操作的准备，可能在转向开始之前合理地影响轨迹。 因此，我们将此实验视为对时间基准的诊断，而非过早执行的证明：规划器可以在不将正确未来意图与当前适当行为截然分开的前提下，编码正确的未来意图。

paragraphs.en: While doPlan uses a common annotation protocol and collects instructions from licensed drivers, we do not independently revalidate every retained instruction through a second round of manual review. We remove exact duplicates and records with malformed or missing fields during cleaning, but some variation may remain in how annotators describe the same observed behavior, maneuver, or scene reference. This variation is expected by design because doPlan does not assume a unique ground-truth instruction for a given observed driving behavior (Sec. III-C ).
paragraphs.zh: 尽管 doPlan 使用通用的标注协议并从持牌驾驶员处收集指令，但我们并未通过第二轮人工审核独立重新验证每一条保留的指令。 在清理过程中，我们移除了完全重复的记录以及字段格式错误或缺失的记录，但标注员对相同观察到的行为、操作或场景参照的描述方式仍可能存在一些差异。 这种差异是设计上的预期结果，因为 doPlan 并未假设对于给定的观察驾驶行为存在唯一的标准指令（第三节 C 部分）。

paragraphs.en: Annotators may also replay the full segment before writing an instruction, which helps capture richer references, deferred actions, and temporally extended behavior, but means that referenced information need not be visible at the evaluation time point. This does not necessarily make the instruction implausible, since a passenger may rely on route knowledge, familiar landmarks, or other contextual information beyond the instantaneous scene. However, doPlan does not currently distinguish such prior knowledge from information visible at the evaluation time point, nor does it annotate a natural instruction-utterance or actionability time. Accordingly, temporal offsets reported in our benchmark should be interpreted relative to the selected evaluation time point rather than as measured instruction-to-action delays.

paragraphs.en: The results of doPlan reveal a distinction that is easy to overlook in language-conditioned driving. Greater sensitivity to passenger language might appear desirable: if the instruction changes, the model should respond. Our guidance ablation shows that Alpamayo 2.0 does become progressively more sensitive as navigation guidance increases. Yet the directional-compliance results show that larger changes in the predicted trajectory do not reliably correspond to behavior in the requested direction. This raises a more fundamental question: what does it mean for a planner to use a passenger instruction? Responding to a change in language is only one part of the problem; the planner must also understand what behavior is being requested and determine how that request should influence the current plan.

paragraphs.en: The difficulty becomes more pronounced when passenger intent spans different temporal horizons or multiple stages of a drive [ 32 ] . Consider “stay behind the bus until the intersection, then move left.” The first part constrains the current behavior, while the second must remain relevant without yet determining the immediate motion. Once the intersection is reached, their roles change. This suggests an instruction lifecycle in which different parts of an instruction may be pending, active, completed, or invalidated as the scene evolves. Variable-horizon, multi-stage instruction following is therefore not simply a matter of remembering language for longer. A planner must preserve unresolved intent while continually determining which parts of that intent are relevant to the present situation.
paragraphs.zh: 当乘客的意图跨越不同的时间范围或驾驶过程的多个阶段时，这种困难会变得更加明显 [ 32 ] 。 考虑“在公交车后面停留直到到达十字路口，然后向左移动。”这一指令。第一部分约束了当前的行为，而第二部分必须保持相关性，但尚未确定即时的动作。 一旦到达十字路口，它们的作用就会发生变化。 这表明存在一个指令生命周期，其中指令的不同部分可能会随着场景的变化而处于待处理、活跃、已完成或无效化的状态。 因此，具有可变时间范围和多个阶段的指令执行，并不仅仅是更长时间地记住语言的问题。 规划器必须保留尚未解决的意图，同时持续确定该意图中哪些部分与当前情况相关。

paragraphs.en: This perspective also changes how instruction following should be evaluated. For a future maneuver, little or no immediate trajectory response may be appropriate; at the same time, preparation such as lane positioning may begin well before the maneuver itself. Trajectory error alone therefore captures only part of the problem, particularly when multiple trajectories may satisfy the same passenger request. Evaluation across temporal horizons may need to consider whether requested events occur, whether stages are completed in the correct order, how model behavior changes as the associated events approach, and whether the resulting motion remains consistent with safe driving. In this setting, instruction following concerns not only similarity to a recorded trajectory, but whether passenger intent is preserved and realized as the drive unfolds.
paragraphs.zh: 这种视角也改变了我们应当如何评估指令遵循的方式。 对于未来的机动操作，可能只需很少甚至没有即时的轨迹响应；与此同时，诸如车道定位之类的准备工作可能早在机动操作本身开始之前就已启动。 因此，仅凭轨迹误差只能反映问题的一部分，尤其是在多个轨迹都可能满足相同乘客需求的情况下。 跨时间范围的评估可能需要考虑：请求的事件是否发生、各阶段是否按正确顺序完成、相关事件临近时模型行为如何变化，以及最终的运动是否仍然符合安全驾驶的要求。 在这种情境下，指令遵循不仅涉及与记录轨迹的相似性，还关乎乘客意图在整个驾驶过程中是否得到保留和实现。

paragraphs.en: This long-horizon setting exposes several research problems that are difficult to study using short, isolated driving clips:
paragraphs.zh: 这种长期规划的场景揭示了若干难以通过短小、孤立的驾驶片段进行研究的难题：

paragraphs.en: Temporal grounding and anticipation: determine when and how a future request should influence the current plan. A maneuver may require preparation before it can be executed, making it important to distinguish appropriate anticipation from premature action.
paragraphs.zh: 时间基准与预测：确定未来请求应在何时以及如何影响当前计划。 某些操作在执行前可能需要准备，因此区分适当的预测与过早行动至关重要。

sents.en: Temporal grounding and anticipation: determine when and how a future request should influence the current plan.
sents.zh: 时间基准与预测：确定未来请求应在何时以及如何影响当前计划。

sents.en: A maneuver may require preparation before it can be executed, making it important to distinguish appropriate anticipation from premature action.
sents.zh: 某些操作在执行前可能需要准备，因此区分适当的预测与过早行动至关重要。

paragraphs.en: Persistent intent and progress: retain unresolved passenger goals while tracking which parts of an instruction have become relevant or have already been completed as the drive evolves.
paragraphs.zh: 持续意图与进展：在行程演变过程中，保留尚未解决的乘客目标，同时追踪指令中哪些部分已变得相关或已完成。

paragraphs.en: Event-conditioned execution: associate requests with the future agents, landmarks, or events on which their execution depends, and recognize when those conditions have been satisfied.
paragraphs.zh: 事件条件执行：将请求与它们执行所依赖的未来智能体、地标或事件关联起来，并识别这些条件何时得到满足。

paragraphs.en: Deferral and revision: distinguish goals that should affect the trajectory now from those that should be deferred, while revising the active plan when changing conditions make the original action infeasible.
paragraphs.zh: 延迟与修订：区分哪些目标应影响当前的行动轨迹，哪些目标应被推迟，同时在条件变化导致原行动不可行时，对当前计划进行修订。

paragraphs.en: These problems shift the role of passenger language from a command that maps directly to the next trajectory to persistent task context that must be maintained over time and whose influence on the active plan changes as the drive unfolds. This capability is also relevant to safety-critical cases in which a conventional minimal-risk stop may itself create hazards, requiring the vehicle to interpret human guidance and revise its motion through a complex scene [ 33 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 这些问题使乘客语言的角色从直接映射到下一个轨迹的命令，转变为一种需要随时间持续保持的任务上下文，其对当前计划的影响会随着驾驶过程的展开而发生变化。 这种能力也适用于对安全至关重要的情况：在这些情况下，传统的最低风险停车本身可能引发危险，因此车辆需要解读人类的指导，并在复杂场景中调整其运动方式 [ 33 ] 。

paragraphs.en: This broader view is also motivated by how passengers naturally communicate with human drivers. Passengers typically express goals, references, preferences, and contingencies rather than precise waypoints or control commands: “turn after that truck,” “stay here until we pass the construction,” or “pull over near the entrance.” doPlan intentionally preserves this free-form interaction rather than reducing passenger language to a fixed navigation vocabulary. Its purpose is not to prescribe a single task or evaluation protocol, but to provide a setting in which researchers can study how passenger intent is retained, grounded, revised, and acted upon across different stages and temporal horizons. More broadly, doPlan supports a shift from isolated command response toward sustained reasoning over passenger intent as the driving environment evolves.
paragraphs.zh: 这种更广泛的视角也受到乘客与人类驾驶员自然交流方式的启发。 乘客通常会表达目标、参照物、偏好和突发情况，而不是精确的路点或控制指令：例如“经过那辆卡车后转弯”“在我们经过施工路段前一直待在这里”或“在入口附近靠边停车”。doPlan 有意保留了这种自由形式的互动，而非将乘客的语言简化为固定的导航词汇。 其目的并非规定单一的任务或评估协议，而是提供一个环境，让研究人员能够研究乘客意图在不同阶段和时间跨度中如何被保留、具象化、修正并付诸行动。 更广泛地说，doPlan 支持从孤立的命令响应模式转向在驾驶环境变化时持续推理乘客意图的模式。

paragraphs.en: We introduced doPlan, a human-annotated dataset for studying language-conditioned autonomous driving over extended and evolving driving contexts. Its 5,154 free-form passenger instructions span 169.1 hours of cumulative instruction-aligned context over 50.9 hours of unique annotated driving and capture a regime in which passenger intent can span multiple stages, depend on future events, and remain relevant well beyond the next predicted trajectory. Evaluating four contemporary language-conditioned driving models illustrates why this regime matters. Sensitivity to passenger language is not the same as following it, and the maneuvers that instructions refer to typically fall well outside current prediction horizons. Neither gap is addressed by better trajectory regression alone.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 doPlan，这是一个由人类标注的数据集，用于研究在长期且不断变化的驾驶情境中受语言影响的自动驾驶。 该数据集包含 5,154 条自由形式的乘客指令，这些指令对应的累计上下文时长为 169.1 小时，覆盖 50.9 小时的唯一标注驾驶过程，并捕捉到一种情境：乘客意图可能跨越多个阶段、依赖未来事件，并在远超下一个预测轨迹的时间范围内保持相关性。 对四种当前的受语言影响的驾驶模型进行评估，可以说明为何这种情境具有重要意义。 对乘客语言的敏感性与遵循其指令并非同一回事，而指令所提及的操作通常远远超出当前的预测范围。 仅通过改进轨迹回归无法解决这两个问题中的任何一个。

paragraphs.en: These gaps point to a broader planning problem that doPlan is designed to support. By pairing free-form passenger language with extended, continuous driving contexts, doPlan provides a setting for developing models that retain unresolved goals, reason over multi-stage instructions, ground references as scenes evolve, distinguish immediate from future intent, and evaluate behavior over horizons where the requested action may not yet be relevant. More broadly, doPlan aims to move language-conditioned driving from isolated command response toward sustained reasoning over passenger intent as the world evolves.
paragraphs.zh: 这些空白指向了一个更广泛的规划问题，而 doPlan 正是为支持这一问题而设计的。 通过将自由形式的乘客语言与扩展的、连续的驾驶情境相结合，doPlan 提供了一个开发模型的环境，这些模型能够保留未解决的目标，对多阶段指令进行推理，在场景演变时确定参考依据，区分即时意图与未来意图，并在所请求动作可能尚未相关的长期时间范围内评估行为。 更广泛地说，doPlan 旨在将语言条件化的驾驶从孤立的命令响应模式，转向在动态变化的世界中持续推理乘客意图的模式。

sents.zh: 这些空白指向了一个更广泛的规划问题，而 doPlan 正是为支持这一问题而设计的。

sents.en: By pairing free-form passenger language with extended, continuous driving contexts, doPlan provides a setting for developing models that retain unresolved goals, reason over multi-stage instructions, ground references as scenes evolve, distinguish immediate from future intent, and evaluate behavior over horizons where the requested action may not yet be relevant.
sents.zh: 通过将自由形式的乘客语言与扩展的、连续的驾驶情境相结合，doPlan 提供了一个开发模型的环境，这些模型能够保留未解决的目标，对多阶段指令进行推理，在场景演变时确定参考依据，区分即时意图与未来意图，并在所请求动作可能尚未相关的长期时间范围内评估行为。

sents.en: More broadly, doPlan aims to move language-conditioned driving from isolated command response toward sustained reasoning over passenger intent as the world evolves.
sents.zh: 更广泛地说，doPlan 旨在将语言条件化的驾驶从孤立的命令响应模式，转向在动态变化的世界中持续推理乘客意图的模式。
